revoked_artifacts.reason: Runtime-invalid build: ADF7021 14.7456 MHz TCXO was incorrectly passed as the STM32 HSE OSC value. 0B-P3 readback matched this artifact exactly but the application produced no GET_VERSION. Automatic exact-stock recovery passed.

targets.notes: Normal product flash operations remain disabled. 0B-P2 remains physically qualified: 131072-byte main-flash geometry, two byte-identical reads, and stock SHA256 4981b35b2d50ada0b09322d9de19dd58a0cbd49eb005693499d1acae92f9d684. The first 0B-P3 write attempt safely failed at the YWD application identity gate and automatically restored exact stock firmware. Root cause was a build-profile clock mix-up: the ADF7021 TCXO is 14.7456 MHz while the pinned upstream MMDVM_HS_Hat STM32 build uses the default 8 MHz HSE. The bad P1 artifact is revoked and the P3 qualification_write gate is closed until a corrected deterministic artifact is rebuilt and separately promoted. GPIO20=BOOT0 and GPIO21=RESET remain physically qualified for application state and explicit system-bootloader entry/restart. Option-byte writes are forbidden.
